text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond ran in the Satsuki Sho. 
However, partly due to another Umamusume 
stumbling, she finished in 3rd place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the wall of the jinx preventing 
the Satono family from conquering a GⅠ. 
But far from being discouraged, Satono 
Diamond is fired up all the more, vowing 
to avenge this at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if they run in different races for 
now, their stride-for-stride journey of 
mutual encouragement continues.
